title: The Flame Weaving Course
summary: A course in drawing fire into threads and ropes and discs and weaving them into screens that guard and bind.

title: A Course in Burning Strikes
summary: A course in hands and elbows and heels that carry heat into a blow and press the burn deep into the target.

title: The Second Primer of Flame Curtains
summary: A second primer for students who hold the basics of fire guarding; it builds screens and domes of flame that also punish a striker.

title: The Smoulder and Sear Handbook
summary: A handbook on burns that last: slow smoulder and clean sear and the way to keep a flame feeding on one place.

title: The Handbook of Quick Fire
summary: A handbook on fire that moves as fast as the student does; it links steps and throws and strikes into one running line.

title: The Course of Tempered Warmth
summary: A course in gentle controlled heat that comforts the hurt and burns poison and taint out of an ally's body.

title: The Fire-Binding Workbook
summary: A workbook on loops and chains and brands of fire that hold a limb or dull a flow of qi for a short time.

title: The Compound Flame Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on linking two or three fire moves into one flowing line so that the burns overlap and stack.
